look_here_first: Look at the basal leaves first: huge, stiff, deeply pinnatifid blades cut almost to the midrib into narrow lobes. Then check the towering flowering stem and yellow ray-and-disk heads. Leaf north-south orientation is variable and not diagnostic by itself.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Massive deeply pinnatifid basal leaves with narrow lobes.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Very tall erect flowering stalk, often above a basal leaf rosette.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Yellow ray florets and central disk florets in sunflower-like heads.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Stiff coarse foliage; inspect leaf dissection rather than flower color.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Leaves sometimes held approximately north-south, but orientation alone is unreliable.
